events.narrative: Pattern consistent with AU4 (brow lowerer) + AU7 (lid tightener) lasting about 333 ms. Strongest evidence: glabella (down, 1.9% IOD), brow mid L (down and inward, 1.3% IOD), brow in R (down, 1.9% IOD).

faithfulness.metric: log-odds of the lowest inclusion probability among the named AUs

limits: Amplitudes are the mean displacement of the dominant ROI of an AU template, in canonical pixels and in percent of the inter-ocular distance (%IOD); they are not muscle forces.

AU probabilities come from a model with hand-written ROI templates (FACS anatomy). On synthetic phantoms its calibration is measured; on real people it has to be evaluated on licensed datasets (see the evaluation protocol).
Category labels are hypotheses derived from AU evidence with an expert prior. They are not a trained recogniser and datasets disagree on how AUs map to emotion labels.
A movement of the face does not tell what a person feels, and micro-movements are not evidence of lying.
